Colombian government reports three killed in rebel attack on military post
items.description: Colombian authorities blame ELN rebel group for attack that reportedly included drones dropping explosives on compound.

items.title: War in Ukraine: Putin, Zelensky order pause in strikes
items.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin on Saturday ordered a 72-hour pause in strikes on Kyiv as US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow.

items.title: Yemen's deadliest fighting in years raises fears of return to all-out war
items.description: Nearly 180 fighters were killed in three days in the southwest of the country, where Houthi forces launched an offensive toward the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait. Four years after the 2022 truce, this outbreak of violence revives the specter of the conflict that has ravaged Yemen since 2014.

items.title: U.S. Envoys Witkoff, Kushner Arrive in Moscow for Peace Talks
items.description: U.S. President Donald Trump suggested on Friday that the U.S. had a fresh concrete proposal aimed at ending the war.

items.title: How the U.S. focus on Iran is fueling a more aggressive Putin
items.description: Trump's top envoys head to Moscow and Kyiv as Putin steps up round the clock bombing of Ukraine. With the U.S. distracted by Iran, is Putin becoming increasingly emboldened?

items.description: Kyrylo Budanov, head of the Office of the President of Ukraine, stated that Russia failed to respond to a proposed ceasefire coinciding with the visit of US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. items.title: Yemen: Fighting intensifies amid Houthi push in the west
items.description: Houthi forces are trying to secure high ground and solidify their control of the entry to the Red Sea in the southwest. The Iran-backed militia abandoned a shaky truce with the Saudi-backed government-in-exile in July.

items.title: 'We expect our sons to be killed,' father of teen shot dead in West Bank tells BBC
items.description: Palestinian teenagers Omar al-Naasan and Khalil Abu Alia were shot dead when Israeli settlers and soldiers entered a village in the occupied West Bank.

items.title: How growing Israeli-Turkish tensions led to a strike on a Syrian air base
items.description: Could the growing regional rivalry between Turkey and Israel lead to a military clash? A recent Israeli strike on an air base in northern Syria illustrated the two countries’ conflicting strategic interests, but analysts say neither wants war.

items.title: Outside forces fuel Sudan war, new report finds
items.description: Foreign recruitment and external support networks are fuelling the brutal conflict in Sudan, independent UN human rights investigators said on Thursday in a new report, calling for accountability as fighting continues between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF).

items.title: Why Was There A Shoot-Out In Kyiv Between Security and Intelligence Agents?
items.description: An armed clash between Ukraine’s military intelligence and security service left three officers wounded in Kyiv. Both sides gave conflicting accounts, while President Zelenskyy called the incident “absolutely disgraceful.”
